text:
A great carved cupboard—the dark oak

emanates the goodness of the old, so old;

it is open, and its depths pour, like aged wine,

dark waves of obsessive aromas.


Stuffed full, it is a jumble of old antiquities,

perfumed yellow sheets, little rags

of women and children, wrinkled laces,

grandmother's shawls with painted dragons.


In it we would find medallions and locks

of white or blond hair, portraits, dried flowers

whose smell mixes with the smell of fruit.


Oh, old cupboard, how many stories you know!

And you would like to tell them; that is why, uncertain, you creak

when your black doors slowly open.

translation.title: The Cupboard
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the cupboard as an archive of scents, keepsakes, and creaking stories.
